bayts.text: You opened for me the gate of gratitude, and the gate of complaint closed with me, worn out,
for what has been effaced of trial and sickness, together with my reckoning, and for my attaining the aim.
Bless with a blessing that makes vision eternal for me with contemplation and leads clarity of speech to me,
with a peace that increases my gains, that bestows on me the most beneficial tables,
upon him who is gladdened by my paronomasia, since he guarded all of me from the slinking Whisperer (Qurʾān 114:4).
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And reward him on my behalf every day with abundant good, clear of blame.
And make my ink and my pens dearer to You than abundant good, O Beloved.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have led steadfastness and certainty to us, O You Who protect us from misery and its people.
Bless with a blessing that makes a delight eternal in the heart of the best of creation, and it remains eternal,
upon him who is gladdened by my constancy, that is, the Possessor of al-Burāq, beloved of the Possessor of Ḥayzūm (Gabriel).
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And protect me in all things from Your stratagem, O You Who granted me, by grace, Your remembrance.
And in interpretation and exegesis lead the hidden things to me with ease.
And preserve my heart and my tongue from idle talk, and with You make me the light of the eloquent.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You inspired me, You granted me success toward good, You preserved me from creation and from harm.
Inspire me to gratitude for the graces, O You Who make clarity and growth eternal,
by Your blessing, with a blessing on my behalf, the Prophet chosen by favour,
with a peace that makes one free of need of others than him, in the outward and the inward, O Enricher (Al-Mughnī),
upon him for whom You accepted my service from me, through him, and spared me the shock.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And turn away, by the right of Your noble Countenance, O Giver of pre-eminence and honour,
toward other than my person the hateful things together with all corruptions, and gather the wishes for me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have turned the harm of every month toward other than my person, without return, and all (months) are alike,
and the harm of the years and the days, through a vigil and a fast that put to shame (by their abundance),
and the harm of humans and the harm of the jinn, in all that is outward and hidden,
and the harm of what is in the earth and the heaven and what is between them; and You led to me what is most upright,
and the harm of the two Abodes: so accept my gratitude and raise it to the Throne, and raise my renown for me (cf. Qurʾān 94:4),
by Your blessing, with a blessing with peace, on my behalf, him who comprises the all-embracing words.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And reward him on my behalf with what cannot be counted of glad tidings: You have helped the victorious.
You helped me through him against the enemies, You preserved me from what breeds sickness.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have separated me from the unbelievers, You have joined me to the grateful.
You have set me apart from unbelief, and You lead to me forever the people of forgiveness.
Bless with a blessing that makes the Accursed and his party despair of me: for You are the Helper,
with a peace that leads the wishes to me from You, as joy for all the trustworthy,
upon him who has made me, with him, one who blesses him and greets him with peace.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make through him my whole being preserved, and grant me forever his veneration.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Bless with a blessing that guards my side, O Best Guardian, to Whom belongs fortification,
with a peace that drives what does not benefit toward others than me, that leads to me what benefits,
upon him to whom I pledged allegiance with my pen and with my ink, effacing my wrongs.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my writing benefits of the Prophet, as through him You guard the ropes of my tent.
You have granted me that no harm return to me, forever, O You Who guard the pearls for me.
You took beforehand what You bought from me, without cancellation, and You sold on my behalf.
By the right of Your noble Countenance grant me what the righteous did not attain before me.
Grant me the remorse of all my enemies for intending my harm; do not drive the Accursed toward me.
And grant me today my clinging to certainty, and with You make me the joy of the God-fearing.
You granted me verification in my taking and in my leaving, and joined me to the faithful guide.
You bestowed on me, O All-Powerful (Al-Qadīr), arrival to You, distinction and detailed exposition.
You banished Iblīs and whoever did evil toward other than my person, and what did harm.
Grant me the permanence of gratitude for the Gardens, with spirit, body and heart,
without doubt and without illusion, and turn toward others than me what draws afflictions.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
